eval: (() => { const g = game, P = g.terrain.places, out = []; P.near(0, 0, 3000, out); const porTipo = {}; for (const p of out) porTipo[p.type] = (porTipo[p.type] || 0) + 1; const mais = (t) => { const l = out.filter(p => p.type === t).sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x, a.z) - Math.hypot(b.x, b.z))[0]; return l && { x: +l.x.toFixed(0), z: +l.z.toFixed(0), dist: +Math.hypot(l.x, l.z).toFixed(0) }; }; window.__P = { tower: out.filter(p => p.type === 'tower').sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x, a.z) - Math.hypot(b.x, b.z))[0], cabin: out.filter(p => p.type === 'cabin').sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x, a.z) - Math.hypot(b.x, b.z))[0], giantTree: out.filter(p => p.type === 'giantTree').sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x, a.z) - Math.hypot(b.x, b.z))[0] }; const area = Math.PI * 3000 * 3000 / 1e6; return { lugaresNum3km: out.length, porKm2: +(out.length / area).toFixed(2), porTipo, torreMaisPerto: mais('tower'), cabanaMaisPerto: mais('cabin'), arvoreMaisPerto: mais('giantTree') }; })()
label: lugares gerados

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, V = p.position.constructor; window.__w = (pl, lx, lz) => ({ x: pl.x + lx * Math.cos(pl.yaw) - lz * Math.sin(pl.yaw), z: pl.z + lx * Math.sin(pl.yaw) + lz * Math.cos(pl.yaw) }); window.__go = (x, z, lookX, lookZ, pitch = 0) => { p.position.set(x, g.terrain.heightAt(x, z), z); p.velocity.set(0, 0, 0); p.yaw = Math.atan2(-(lookX - x), -(lookZ - z)); p.pitch = pitch; g.chunks.warmup(p.position); p.update(1 / 30); }; window.__walk = (keys, secs) => { for (const k of keys) g.input.down.add(k); let maxY = -1e9; for (let i = 0; i < secs * 30; i++) { p.update(1 / 30); maxY = Math.max(maxY, p.position.y); } for (const k of keys) g.input.down.delete(k); return maxY; }; for (const M of [g.boars, g.deer]) { for (let i = M.active.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) M.release(i); M.frozen = true; M.spawnTimer = 1e9; } g.birds.frozen = true; g.journal.clear(); return 'pronto'; })()

(() => { const g = game, p = g.player, T = __P.tower; const base = __w(T, 0, 3.4); __go(base.x, base.z, T.x, T.z, 0); const noChao = +(p.position.y - T.y).toFixed(2); const topo = __walk(['KeyW'], 4.5); const fim = { y: +(p.position.y - T.y).toFixed(2), naEscada: p.climbing, distDoCentro: +Math.hypot(p.position.x - T.x, p.position.z - T.z).toFixed(2), noChaoDaPlataforma: p.onGround }; return { alturaDaPlataforma: +(T.floorY - T.y).toFixed(2), comecouA: noChao, maisAltoQueChegou: +(topo - T.y).toFixed(2), depoisDeAndar: fim }; })()
label: torre: sobe pela escada (W olhando reto)

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, T = __P.tower; const back = __w(T, 0, -8); p.yaw = Math.atan2(-(back.x - p.position.x), -(back.z - p.position.z)); __walk(['KeyW'], 3); return { segueNaPlataforma: +(p.position.y - T.y).toFixed(2), distDoCentro: +Math.hypot(p.position.x - T.x, p.position.z - T.z).toFixed(2), gradeSegurou: Math.hypot(p.position.x - T.x, p.position.z - T.z) < 1.8 }; })()

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, T = __P.tower; const out = __w(T, 0, 12); p.yaw = Math.atan2(-(out.x - p.position.x), -(out.z - p.position.z)); p.pitch = 0.05; p.update(1 / 30); g.discoverPlaces(); return { aviso: document.querySelector('.hud-note').textContent, lugares: g.journal.view().places }; })()

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, T = __P.tower; const gap = __w(T, 0, 1.4); p.position.x = gap.x; p.position.z = gap.z; p.position.y = T.floorY; p.velocity.set(0, 0, 0); const out = __w(T, 0, 6); p.yaw = Math.atan2(-(out.x - p.position.x), -(out.z - p.position.z)); p.pitch = -0.7; __walk(['KeyW'], 6); return { alturaFinal: +(p.position.y - g.terrain.heightAt(p.position.x, p.position.z)).toFixed(2), naEscada: p.climbing }; })()

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, T = __P.tower; const view = __w(T, 18, 26); __go(view.x, view.z, T.x, T.z, 0.12); return 'torre vista de fora'; })()

(() => { const g = game, p = g.player, C = __P.cabin; const door = __w(C, 0, 5); __go(door.x, door.z, C.x, C.z, -0.05); const antes = +(p.position.y - C.floorY).toFixed(2); __walk(['KeyW'], 2.2); return { antesDaPorta: antes, dentro: { distDoCentro: +Math.hypot(p.position.x - C.x, p.position.z - C.z).toFixed(2), alturaNoAssoalho: +(p.position.y - C.floorY).toFixed(2) } }; })()
label: cabana: entra pela porta

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, C = __P.cabin; const back = __w(C, 0, -10); p.yaw = Math.atan2(-(back.x - p.position.x), -(back.z - p.position.z)); __walk(['KeyW'], 3); const [lx, lz] = [(p.position.x - C.x) * Math.cos(C.yaw) + (p.position.z - C.z) * Math.sin(C.yaw), -(p.position.x - C.x) * Math.sin(C.yaw) + (p.position.z - C.z) * Math.cos(C.yaw)]; return { posLocal: [+lx.toFixed(2), +lz.toFixed(2)], paredeSegurou: lz > -1.9 }; })()

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, V = p.position.constructor, C = __P.cabin; const side = __w(C, 12, 0); __go(side.x, side.z, C.x, C.z, 0.03); const cam = g.engine.camera; const dir = new V(C.x - cam.position.x, 0, C.z - cam.position.z).normalize(); const m = g.hunting.measure(cam.position, dir); return { distanciaAoCentro: +Math.hypot(C.x - cam.position.x, C.z - cam.position.z).toFixed(1), telemetroBateNaParede: +m.toFixed(1) }; })()

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, A = __P.giantTree; const near = __w(A, 6, 0); __go(near.x, near.z, A.x, A.z, 0); __walk(['KeyW'], 3); return { distanciaAoTroncoDepoisDeEmpurrar: +Math.hypot(p.position.x - A.x, p.position.z - A.z).toFixed(2), raioDoTronco: +(0.42 * 3 * 0.95).toFixed(2) }; })()

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, A = __P.giantTree; const far = __w(A, 70, 20); __go(far.x, far.z, A.x, A.z, 0.18); g.discoverPlaces(); return 'árvore gigante de longe'; })()

(() => { const g = game, out = []; let dentro = 0; for (const pl of Object.values(__P)) { g.chunks.warmup(new g.player.position.constructor(pl.x, pl.y, pl.z)); for (const c of g.chunks.loaded.values()) { for (let i = 0; i < c.colliders.length; i += 3) if (Math.hypot(c.colliders[i] - pl.x, c.colliders[i + 1] - pl.z) < pl.radius) dentro++; } } const t0 = performance.now(); const V = g.player.position.constructor; const o = new V(__P.cabin.x + 50, __P.cabin.y + 1.5, __P.cabin.z); const d = new V(-1, 0, 0); for (let i = 0; i < 2000; i++) g.terrain.places.raycast(o, d, 400); return { troncosEPedrasDentroDosLugares: dentro, msPorRaycast: +((performance.now() - t0) / 2000).toFixed(4), caderno: g.journal.view().places }; })()
